tables.name: t
tables.columns: k UInt64, u0 UInt64, u1 UInt64, u2 UInt64, u3 UInt64, event_time DateTime

inserts.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number * {n} + {i} AS k, sipHash64(k, {seed}) AS u0, u0 % 1000 AS u1, k * 7 AS u2, intDiv(k, 3) AS u3, now() - {i} AS event_time FROM numbers({rows})

description: Two 100 000-row Compact parts inserted on r1 and fetched by r2 onto its hot volume; the window starts moves on both replicas.
